author: Codex API deployment engineer
changed: Accepted the exact root-owned Debian mirror-list transport after its actual safe first refusal.
proves: The downloader keeps the exact package SHA/version/size and validates only a bounded no-follow root-owned mirror list of official Debian origins; private or writable mirror sources refuse.
limits: The first setup failure is retained. This does not activate a service, prove TLS or grant a new download origin.
